base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1."XCL_027" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_022" = T3."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_002" = 'Neutral' AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Brown' AND T1."XCL_029" < 100 AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
JOIN alignment al ON s.XCL_027 = al.XCL_001
JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005
WHERE al.XCL_002 = 'Neutral'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Brown'
  AND s.XCL_020 < 100
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1
